responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: As a Product designer you connect product strategy to product execution.
You enjoy solving complex digital challenges and can drive a creative and collaborative approach to product development.
Your ultimate goal is to boost usability and effectiveness through designs that look and work just great.
You never take your eyes off the end user, because you know they are the ones who define the success of your work.
Provide best-in-class product design
Solve customer problems through thoughtful and elegant user experience design.
Translate visions for digital products, platforms and services into compelling UI.
Present your work to the client in well-crafted deliverables such as wireframes, clickable prototypes or concept presentations.
Use an analytical mindset and critical thinking to validate/test and lead to user-centered solutions.
Document detailed interaction models, UI specifications and visual language to ensure design consistency.
See the bigger picture
You understand that great UX is the result of far more than just great interaction or visual design.
You start from the Why (i.e. business objectives and user needs), and critically reflect on the best path towards success.
You can present concepts in a compelling strategic narrative (vs. as a loose collection of features).
You have strong affinity with user research, service design, business design, and platform-thinking.
You contribute to shaping product strategy, bringing a design perspective to business decisions.
Lead and take charge
Given that you will be working with leading companies on key strategic challenges, you demonstrate a high degree of ownership and responsibility.
Act as a strong and passionate advocate for users and their needs; champion product quality and experience design.
Communicate your ideas, opinions and design decisions effectively to ensure successful outcomes.
Thrive in uncertainty, you can design a process or workshop to provide clarity when needed.
Be self-managed and coordinate collaboration with the project team to make sure your designs get translated into the actual product with quality and precision.

Participate in growing our design practice by keeping your eyes open for important evolutions in our sector (including AI and emerging technologies) and sharing ideas to translate them into our projects.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted design partner.

responsibilities: As a Product designer you connect product strategy to product execution.
You enjoy solving complex digital challenges and can drive a creative and collaborative approach to product development.
Your ultimate goal is to boost usability and effectiveness through designs that look and work just great.
You never take your eyes off the end user, because you know they are the ones who define the success of your work.
Provide best-in-class product design
Solve customer problems through thoughtful and elegant user experience design.
Translate visions for digital products, platforms and services into compelling UI.
Present your work to the client in well-crafted deliverables such as wireframes, clickable prototypes or concept presentations.
Use an analytical mindset and critical thinking to validate/test and lead to user-centered solutions.
Document detailed interaction models, UI specifications and visual language to ensure design consistency.
See the bigger picture
You understand that great UX is the result of far more than just great interaction or visual design.
You start from the Why (i.e. business objectives and user needs), and critically reflect on the best path towards success.
You can present concepts in a compelling strategic narrative (vs. as a loose collection of features).
You have strong affinity with user research, service design, business design, and platform-thinking.
You contribute to shaping product strategy, bringing a design perspective to business decisions.
Lead and take charge
Given that you will be working with leading companies on key strategic challenges, you demonstrate a high degree of ownership and responsibility.
Act as a strong and passionate advocate for users and their needs; champion product quality and experience design.
Communicate your ideas, opinions and design decisions effectively to ensure successful outcomes.
Thrive in uncertainty, you can design a process or workshop to provide clarity when needed.
Be self-managed and coordinate collaboration with the project team to make sure your designs get translated into the actual product with quality and precision.

Participate in growing our design practice by keeping your eyes open for important evolutions in our sector (including AI and emerging technologies) and sharing ideas to translate them into our projects.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted design partner.

matches.job_skill: 5+ years of experience in Digital Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a proven track record of delivering impactful digital products.
Solid understanding and practical experience with research methods and discovery practices.
You can design and lead research activities and translate findings into actionable design decisions.
You express yourself, your ideas and your work fluently in Dutch and English (both spoken and written).
Proficient in working with common design tools (Figma, Sketch, etc.), prototyping tools (Principle, ProtoPie, Framer, etc.) and user testing tools (Useberry, Maze, UserTesting, etc.).
Solid experience working with scalable design systems and atomic design principles.
You understand how to build and maintain design consistency across multiple products or platforms.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
You can present confidently to stakeholders at various levels and articulate the value of your design decisions.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and tasks effectively.

A fresh and innovative perspective on the future of digital design (including AI-driven experiences) and a desire to continually learn, experiment and develop your skill set (both hard and soft skills) to grow and evolve as a designer.
You understand end-users are diverse and have demonstrated experience designing for accessibility and inclusion.
Good working knowledge of Agile development processes (Scrum, Kanban, Lean UX, etc.).
Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, React, React Native, etc.) to effectively collaborate with engineers and understand technical possibilities and constraints.
A strategic mindset that connects design decisions to business outcomes and user value.
Experience with brand strategy and visual identity systems is highly valued.
Interest or experience with AI and emerging technologies and how they can enhance product design and user experiences.
What we offer
Joining In The Pocket means becoming part of a team that shapes the future of our clients’ businesses across Europe.
Here’s what you can look forward to:
You’ll start with a permanent contract in a role that comes with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one.
We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and the value you bring.
You’ll have a mobility budget that lets you decide how to get around, your way.
Life at In The Pocket isn’t just about work, we host team events throughout the year to celebrate, connect, and have fun together.
Learning never stops here, so after six months, you’ll receive a dedicated learning and development budget to keep growing your skills and exploring new horizons.

responsibilities: As a Product designer you connect product strategy to product execution.
You enjoy solving complex digital challenges and can drive a creative and collaborative approach to product development.
Your ultimate goal is to boost usability and effectiveness through designs that look and work just great.
You never take your eyes off the end user, because you know they are the ones who define the success of your work.
Provide best-in-class product design
Solve customer problems through thoughtful and elegant user experience design.
Translate visions for digital products, platforms and services into compelling UI.
Present your work to the client in well-crafted deliverables such as wireframes, clickable prototypes or concept presentations.
Use an analytical mindset and critical thinking to validate/test and lead to user-centered solutions.
Document detailed interaction models, UI specifications and visual language to ensure design consistency.
See the bigger picture
You understand that great UX is the result of far more than just great interaction or visual design.
You start from the Why (i.e. business objectives and user needs), and critically reflect on the best path towards success.
You can present concepts in a compelling strategic narrative (vs. as a loose collection of features).
You have strong affinity with user research, service design, business design, and platform-thinking.
You contribute to shaping product strategy, bringing a design perspective to business decisions.
Lead and take charge
Given that you will be working with leading companies on key strategic challenges, you demonstrate a high degree of ownership and responsibility.
Act as a strong and passionate advocate for users and their needs; champion product quality and experience design.
Communicate your ideas, opinions and design decisions effectively to ensure successful outcomes.
Thrive in uncertainty, you can design a process or workshop to provide clarity when needed.
Be self-managed and coordinate collaboration with the project team to make sure your designs get translated into the actual product with quality and precision.

Participate in growing our design practice by keeping your eyes open for important evolutions in our sector (including AI and emerging technologies) and sharing ideas to translate them into our projects.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted design partner.

responsibilities: As a Product designer you connect product strategy to product execution.
You enjoy solving complex digital challenges and can drive a creative and collaborative approach to product development.
Your ultimate goal is to boost usability and effectiveness through designs that look and work just great.
You never take your eyes off the end user, because you know they are the ones who define the success of your work.
Provide best-in-class product design
Solve customer problems through thoughtful and elegant user experience design.
Translate visions for digital products, platforms and services into compelling UI.
Present your work to the client in well-crafted deliverables such as wireframes, clickable prototypes or concept presentations.
Use an analytical mindset and critical thinking to validate/test and lead to user-centered solutions.
Document detailed interaction models, UI specifications and visual language to ensure design consistency.
See the bigger picture
You understand that great UX is the result of far more than just great interaction or visual design.
You start from the Why (i.e. business objectives and user needs), and critically reflect on the best path towards success.
You can present concepts in a compelling strategic narrative (vs. as a loose collection of features).
You have strong affinity with user research, service design, business design, and platform-thinking.
You contribute to shaping product strategy, bringing a design perspective to business decisions.
Lead and take charge
Given that you will be working with leading companies on key strategic challenges, you demonstrate a high degree of ownership and responsibility.
Act as a strong and passionate advocate for users and their needs; champion product quality and experience design.
Communicate your ideas, opinions and design decisions effectively to ensure successful outcomes.
Thrive in uncertainty, you can design a process or workshop to provide clarity when needed.
Be self-managed and coordinate collaboration with the project team to make sure your designs get translated into the actual product with quality and precision.

Participate in growing our design practice by keeping your eyes open for important evolutions in our sector (including AI and emerging technologies) and sharing ideas to translate them into our projects.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted design partner.

responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: As a Product designer you connect product strategy to product execution.
You enjoy solving complex digital challenges and can drive a creative and collaborative approach to product development.
Your ultimate goal is to boost usability and effectiveness through designs that look and work just great.
You never take your eyes off the end user, because you know they are the ones who define the success of your work.
Provide best-in-class product design
Solve customer problems through thoughtful and elegant user experience design.
Translate visions for digital products, platforms and services into compelling UI.
Present your work to the client in well-crafted deliverables such as wireframes, clickable prototypes or concept presentations.
Use an analytical mindset and critical thinking to validate/test and lead to user-centered solutions.
Document detailed interaction models, UI specifications and visual language to ensure design consistency.
See the bigger picture
You understand that great UX is the result of far more than just great interaction or visual design.
You start from the Why (i.e. business objectives and user needs), and critically reflect on the best path towards success.
You can present concepts in a compelling strategic narrative (vs. as a loose collection of features).
You have strong affinity with user research, service design, business design, and platform-thinking.
You contribute to shaping product strategy, bringing a design perspective to business decisions.
Lead and take charge
Given that you will be working with leading companies on key strategic challenges, you demonstrate a high degree of ownership and responsibility.
Act as a strong and passionate advocate for users and their needs; champion product quality and experience design.
Communicate your ideas, opinions and design decisions effectively to ensure successful outcomes.
Thrive in uncertainty, you can design a process or workshop to provide clarity when needed.
Be self-managed and coordinate collaboration with the project team to make sure your designs get translated into the actual product with quality and precision.

Participate in growing our design practice by keeping your eyes open for important evolutions in our sector (including AI and emerging technologies) and sharing ideas to translate them into our projects.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted design partner.

What we offer
Joining In The Pocket means becoming part of a team that shapes the future of our clients’ businesses across Europe.
Here’s what you can look forward to:
You’ll start with a permanent contract in a role that comes with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one.
We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and the value you bring.
You’ll have a mobility budget that lets you decide how to get around, your way.
Life at In The Pocket isn’t just about work, we host team events throughout the year to celebrate, connect, and have fun together.
Learning never stops here, so after six months, you’ll receive a dedicated learning and development budget to keep growing your skills and exploring new horizons.

responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: Data sits at the heart of the company.

This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy.

Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.
In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability.
You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.
Key
Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.
Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.
Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.
Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.

responsibilities: As a Product designer you connect product strategy to product execution.
You enjoy solving complex digital challenges and can drive a creative and collaborative approach to product development.
Your ultimate goal is to boost usability and effectiveness through designs that look and work just great.
You never take your eyes off the end user, because you know they are the ones who define the success of your work.
Provide best-in-class product design
Solve customer problems through thoughtful and elegant user experience design.
Translate visions for digital products, platforms and services into compelling UI.
Present your work to the client in well-crafted deliverables such as wireframes, clickable prototypes or concept presentations.
Use an analytical mindset and critical thinking to validate/test and lead to user-centered solutions.
Document detailed interaction models, UI specifications and visual language to ensure design consistency.
See the bigger picture
You understand that great UX is the result of far more than just great interaction or visual design.
You start from the Why (i.e. business objectives and user needs), and critically reflect on the best path towards success.
You can present concepts in a compelling strategic narrative (vs. as a loose collection of features).
You have strong affinity with user research, service design, business design, and platform-thinking.
You contribute to shaping product strategy, bringing a design perspective to business decisions.
Lead and take charge
Given that you will be working with leading companies on key strategic challenges, you demonstrate a high degree of ownership and responsibility.
Act as a strong and passionate advocate for users and their needs; champion product quality and experience design.
Communicate your ideas, opinions and design decisions effectively to ensure successful outcomes.
Thrive in uncertainty, you can design a process or workshop to provide clarity when needed.
Be self-managed and coordinate collaboration with the project team to make sure your designs get translated into the actual product with quality and precision.

Participate in growing our design practice by keeping your eyes open for important evolutions in our sector (including AI and emerging technologies) and sharing ideas to translate them into our projects.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted design partner.

matches.job_skill: Solid experience working with scalable design systems and atomic design principles.
You understand how to build and maintain design consistency across multiple products or platforms.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
You can present confidently to stakeholders at various levels and articulate the value of your design decisions.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and tasks effectively.

A fresh and innovative perspective on the future of digital design (including AI-driven experiences) and a desire to continually learn, experiment and develop your skill set (both hard and soft skills) to grow and evolve as a designer.
You understand end-users are diverse and have demonstrated experience designing for accessibility and inclusion.
Good working knowledge of Agile development processes (Scrum, Kanban, Lean UX, etc.).
Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, React, React Native, etc.) to effectively collaborate with engineers and understand technical possibilities and constraints.
A strategic mindset that connects design decisions to business outcomes and user value.
Experience with brand strategy and visual identity systems is highly valued.
Interest or experience with AI and emerging technologies and how they can enhance product design and user experiences.
What we offer
Joining In The Pocket means becoming part of a team that shapes the future of our clients’ businesses across Europe.
Here’s what you can look forward to:
You’ll start with a permanent contract in a role that comes with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one.
We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and the value you bring.
You’ll have a mobility budget that lets you decide how to get around, your way.
Life at In The Pocket isn’t just about work, we host team events throughout the year to celebrate, connect, and have fun together.
Learning never stops here, so after six months, you’ll receive a dedicated learning and development budget to keep growing your skills and exploring new horizons.
